text:
sara: quick design sync re: Metrics > Overview chart density. With 3+ series the minor ticks and gridlines make the panel feel busy; on narrow screens legend wraps and hides series labels. anyone have compact affordance ideas? devin: saw this on mobile too. thought: a per-panel "compact" mode that reduces minor ticks, collapses gridlines, and stacks legend into a vertical overflow. toggle persisted per-dashboard. :iphone: alex: compact mode is fine but ensure keyboard + screen-reader users can still perceive the scale. hiding ticks visually requires a textual descriptor or focusable markers. mike: implementation proposal: three rendering presets \u2014 Raw (full ticks, full grid), Trend (reduced ticks, light smoothing), Compact (no minor ticks, minimal grid, stacked legend). default preset chosen by dashboard template. sara: for legend density, propose split into Primary / Secondary groups. Primary metrics show inline, secondary collapsed under "More" chevron. makes small panels readable. also make legend rows tappable with a 44px min hit area to avoid fat-finger taps. rachel: +1 on hit area. on touch long-press should surface full metric name + last value tooltip, so we don't need full inline names in tight layouts. also think about focus outline for keyboard users when legend is collapsed. devin: outlier handling thought: instead of clipping values, consider "peripheral dimming" where spikes keep their true value but are visually de-emphasized (lower opacity + thin stroke). keeps data integrity. alex: accessibility nit: add aria-describedby summarizing the visible data range, series count, and latest point. sample wrapper code to include in chart component: ```
Latest for primary series: 130ms at 14:22. Visible range: 8ms9s. Showing 4 series. Compact mode active.
``` mike: love that. copy/axis tweak: use SI prefixes (k, M) on axis ticks but reveal full unit on hover/focus like "1.2M (million)". also allow toggle to use exact numbers for finance-y dashboards. sara: smoothing algorithm: moving average is too blunt on short windows. recommend EMA with 2 presets: EMA alpha=0.25 (light) and alpha=0.6 (aggressive) + custom alpha. small inline control: "Smoothing: Off / EMA 0.25 / EMA 0.6 / Custom". devs: feasible? devin: yeah, backend can expose EMA param and client can persist per-panel. i'll mock control in the panel header and a11y labels for each option. rachel: keyboard + screen reader: ensure smoothing control is a combobox with aria-live updates when switched so users get announced changes. also include an "explain" tooltip linking to docs. sara: last UX detail: when compact mode hides minor ticks, provide a visual toggle that briefly shows the ticks on hover/focus (like a hint) so users can inspect exact alignment without leaving compact mode. design-bot: reminder: add accessibility checklist items to ticket A11Y-87 and include the aria-desc example. devin: i'll prot a compact ticks + legend split mock later today and drop in this thread. :thumbsup: sara: thanks all, ping me for review when mock is up.
